summary: Thread actions in an agent conversation or a thread tab now use alt+z, alt+n, alt+v, alt+p and alt+r, so bare letters always type there

replay.detail: Key handling and rendering only; no durable data is replayed.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread access rules are unchanged. No thread key acts while a message box, rename editor, find or form has the keys.

compatibility.detail: In an agent's conversation and in a thread tab, z, n, v, p and r no longer close, rename, mark read, open or retry the marked thread. They type instead: the agent's message box, or the tab's reply box. The actions move to alt+z, alt+n, alt+v, alt+p and alt+r, and the thread's buttons show those keycaps. An Inbox item keeps the bare letters.

manual.detail: In fractal tui with thread write access, expand a thread in an agent's conversation and press z: the letter starts a message to the agent. Press Esc, then alt+z: the thread closes. In a thread tab, n starts a reply and alt+n opens the rename editor. On an Inbox thread, z still closes it. The help (?) lists the alt keys under threads. Terminals must send Option/Alt as Meta (on macOS, set Option as Alt).

recovery.detail: Presentation and key routing only; no daemon state, pairings or drafts change.
